tools_used: metrics/statpack.md (sal-v4 band table, CVSG and relist cuts)
helpful: Full-text petition and BIO in record/documents/ carried almost all of the case-specific signal; the BIO's vehicle section in particular.
The sal-v4 segment table's bracketed reached figures made the strictly-prior pooled anchor a one-line computation.
gaps: fedcourts query has no CVSG filter, so same-moment priors (petitions after a CVSG, by SG recommendation and outcome) cannot be pulled; a cvsg-only flag or an SG-recommendation column would make the CVSG moment's main variable observable.
The CourtListener cluster for the decision below carried no panel or author metadata, so whether there was a separate writing below was unknowable without fetching the opinion text.
A statpack cut of CVSG petitions by SG recommendation (grant / deny / other) would let the largest adjustment in this cell rest on a committed number.
notes: The first of the two recorded distributions preceded the Court's request for a response, so distribution_count overstates the number of conferences at which the petition was actually considered with a BIO on file.
